events.title: Cooking Adventure LIVE – Can We Get 3 Stars?
events.summary: Welcome to the Cooking Adventure LIVE stream!Join us as we take on fast-paced restaurant stages, serve hungry customers, upgrade our kitchen, and aim for the perfect 3-star score.🍳 Explore unique restaurants ⭐ Challenge yourself to earn 3 stars 🔥 Experience fast-paced cooking gameplay 👩‍🍳 Meet Noma and the world of Cooking AdventureTry the Cooking Adventure Demo for free on Steam!Add Cooking Adventure to your Wishlist and follow us for more updates!
